BiblicalUsage: Two runs through the whole Bible from the first chapter: two great lights set in the sky, two cherubim over the mercy seat, two goats on the Day of Atonement, two witnesses required before a man can be condemned. God pairs things — lights, tablets, goats, witnesses — and the pairs carry the weight.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that two is the number of witness in Scripture, and I take that seriously. One voice can be mistaken, but two independent witnesses establish a matter, and that is how God has arranged both His law and His testimony about His Son.
